title: RelativeScheduledMessage

id.description: ID of the relative scheduled message

content.description: Text content of the relative scheduled message

time_of_day.description: Time of day when scheduled messages will be sent in HH:MM format (with hours from 00 to 23)

date_variable.description: Custom contact variable storing date or date/time values relative to which messages will be scheduled.

offset_scale.description: The type of interval that will be used to adjust the scheduled date relative to the date stored in the contact's date_variable, when offset_count is non-zero (I=minutes, D=day, W=week, M=month, Y=year)

offset_count.description: The number of days/weeks/months/years to adjust the date of the scheduled message relative relative to the date stored in the contact's date_variable. May be positive, negative, or zero.

rrule.description: Recurrence rule for recurring scheduled messages, e.g. 'FREQ=MONTHLY' or 'FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=2'; see [RFC2445](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc2445#section-4.3.10).

end_time.description: Time after which recurring messages will stop (not applicable to non-recurring scheduled messages)

timezone_id.description: Timezone ID used to compute times for recurring messages; see [List of tz database time zones Wikipedia article](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones).

recipients_str.description: A string with a human readable description of the recipient

group_id.description: ID of the group to send the message to (null if the recipient is an individual contact)

contact_id.description: ID of the contact to send the message to (null if the recipient is a group)

to_number.description: Phone number to send the message to (null if the recipient is a group)

route_id.description: ID of the phone or route the message will be sent from

service_id.description: The service associated with this message (for voice calls, the service defines the call flow)

audio_url.description: For voice calls, the URL of an MP3 file to play when the contact answers the call

tts_lang.description: For voice calls, the language of the text-to-speech voice

tts_voice.description: For voice calls, the text-to-speech voice

time_created.description: Time the relative scheduled message was created in Telerivet

replace_variables.description: Set to true if Telerivet will render variables like [[contact.name]] in the message content, false otherwise

track_clicks.description: If true, URLs in the message content will automatically be replaced with unique short URLs

url.description: URL of the media file. Note: For files stored by Telerivet (including uploaded files and incoming media attachments), the URL is temporary and may not be valid for more than 1 day.

type.description: MIME type of the media file

file_id.description: ID of the stored file, if applicable

media.description: Array of media attachments for the text message. This property is undefined for messages that do not contain media files.

route_params.description:
Route-specific parameters to use when sending the message. 

 When sending messages via chat apps such as WhatsApp, the route_params parameter can be used to send messages with app-specific features such as quick replies and link buttons.

 For more details, see Route-Specific Parameters.

vars.description:
Custom variables stored for this scheduled message (copied to each ScheduledMessage and Message when sent). Variable names may be up to 32 characters in length and can contain the characters a-z, A-Z, 0-9, and _.
 Values may be strings, numbers, or boolean (true/false).
 String values may be up to 4096 bytes in length when encoded as UTF-8.
 Up to 100 variables are supported per object.
 Setting a variable to null will delete the variable.

label_ids.description: IDs of labels to add to the Message

project_id.description: ID of the project this relative scheduled message belongs to

description:
A relative scheduled message is a message that is scheduled relative to a date stored as a custom field for each recipient contact.
 This allows scheduling messages on a different date for each contact, for example on their birthday, a certain number of days before an appointment, or a certain number of days after enrolling in a campaign.

 Telerivet will automatically create a ScheduledMessage for each contact matching a RelativeScheduledMessage.

 Any service that can be manually triggered for a contact (including polls) may also be scheduled via a relative scheduled message, whether or not the service actually sends a message.
